goal: Make ProviderJob DAG execution the parallel project-work contract and restrict persistent Codex supervision to evidence-bound false-pass auditing with deterministic repair routing.
acceptance_criteria: Provider remains the only generated-candidate author and customer-project semantic repair owner.
ProviderJob workers return isolated PatchSets, enforce owns, honor dependencies and concurrency caps, merge deterministically, retry only failed jobs, and reuse PASS jobs.
Codex audits only high-value positive transitions and ordinary Provider/test failures invoke no Codex.
Audit results use one canonical action and scope model with deterministic routing.
Kernel repair is a separate allowlisted workspace-write mirror requiring reproduction and regression checks.
False-pass cases A-E, focused tests, kernel guard, and bounded verification pass.

quality_metrics.measure: fault routing accuracy and clean-path availability
quality_metrics.target: A-E all pass and an ordinary failure records zero Codex invocations
quality_metrics.method: fault-injection suite and durable route/metric receipt inspection

quality_metrics.measure: safe real temporal overlap of independent jobs
quality_metrics.target: provider_peak_concurrency >= 2 under a two-party barrier while dependency and ownership tests pass
quality_metrics.method: barrier/event timing, deterministic merge assertions, localized retry and reuse tests

quality_metrics.target: all focused and bounded verification commands pass

prevention: Freeze Provider, CGKN, Codex, evidence, package, and delivery authority before code changes.
assurance: Review production call graph before modification and keep local_packager as the only exit.
control: Run protocol/router/kernel repair/parallel executor tests before Provider and delivery regressions.
improvement: Track Provider and Codex invocation metrics in durable support receipts and use failures to localize future work.

interface_expectations: scripts/provider_jobs.py owns the minimal ProviderJob/PatchSet scheduling contract.
scripts/cgkn_supervision_protocol.py owns canonical audit results and legacy boundary mapping.
scripts/cgkn_supervision_router.py owns deterministic next-action receipts without an LLM.
scripts/governed_kernel_repair.py owns isolated allowlisted Codex write execution.
scripts/codex_conversation.py emits only integration-complete and pre-public-delivery audits in its current production route.

feedback: Local fault injection, temporal concurrency, focused Provider, kernel, delivery, and 1404-test quick verification passed. Live Qwen3.8 Provider acceptance is blocked by a repeatable TLS transport failure.

worked: Reusing the existing leaf DAG and adding one minimal ProviderJob/PatchSet contract increased observable parallelism without creating a second generation route.
did_not_work: The first 300-second quick bound was too short; a complete run required about 804 seconds. The full_all profile still exceeds a 180-second bounded run because an identified legacy agent-conversation test alone takes about 60 seconds.
experiments: Measure the next credentialed run's two positive Codex audits against Provider call count and wall time before tuning audit frequency.
